suggestions.label: Suggestions
suggestions.description: Members propose ideas (with a Steam link), voted 👍/👎 and decided on by staff.

command.description: Submit a suggestion to the server.
command.steamOpt: Steam link of the game to suggest (optional).

suggestions.notConfigured: ❌ No suggestions channel is configured. An admin must set one on the dashboard.
suggestions.channelGone: ❌ The suggestions channel cannot be found. Please tell an administrator.
suggestions.steamFetchFailed: ❌ Could not fetch the game info from Steam. Please try again later.
suggestions.sendError: ❌ Could not post the suggestion (check my permissions in the channel).

feedback.disabled: ❌ This module is disabled on this server.
feedback.staffOnly: ⛔ Only staff can decide on suggestions.

suggestions.limitReached: ❌ You reached your limit of {max} pending suggestion(s).

channelIds.label: Suggestion channels
channelIds.help: Where suggestions are posted. Several channels are allowed — the author picks one when submitting. While the list is empty the command refuses to post: this is the one genuinely required setting.

staffRoleId.label: Staff role
staffRoleId.help: The role allowed to approve, reject or mark under review. The decision buttons stay visible to everyone but only answer to that role; server administrators qualify without holding it.

createThread.label: Create a thread per suggestion
createThread.help: A discussion thread is created under each posted suggestion, so debate does not flood the channel. Avoid it if the server is near its active-thread limit: creation then fails and the suggestion is posted on its own.

maxPending.label: Limit of pending suggestions / member
maxPending.help: How many untreated suggestions one member may have at a time. Once theirs is approved or rejected, the slot frees up. 0 lifts the limit — at the risk of a single member filling the queue.

rewardCoins.label: Coins awarded on approval
rewardCoins.help: Paid to the author when their suggestion is approved, once per suggestion. Requires the Economy module to be on: without it nothing is paid and nothing says so. 0 to grant nothing.

rewardItemId.label: Item awarded on approval
rewardItemId.help: The id of a catalogue item, handed to the author on top of the coins. An unknown id is silently ignored — check it in the catalogue before writing it here. Empty to hand out nothing.

dynamicColor.label: Dynamic embed colour (based on the votes)
dynamicColor.help: The box turns green or red as votes come in, before staff decide anything. Off, it keeps a neutral colour until the decision — plainer, and it avoids a close vote looking like a rejection.

roleLimits.label: Limits per role
roleLimits.help: These take precedence over the general limit above. A member holding several of these roles gets the highest limit — not the lowest: these rows are there to reward, not to punish. A limit of 0 means unlimited.

g0.label: 💡 Suggestions
g0.description: A suggestion submitted with /suggestion is posted in a dedicated channel with two vote buttons. Staff approve, reject or mark it under review, with a reason. Suggestions and votes are stored in the database: the counters do not reset after a restart.
